title: Bandgap-engineered nitrogen plasma functionalized biochar-TiO2 composite for enhanced antibiotic photodegradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13147-13161
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09288D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rayhan Bin Masud, Samiha Raisa Alam, Hridoy Roy, Mohammad Jellur Rahman, Md. Shahinoor Islam
The photocatalytic efficacy of plasma-doped TiO2-biochar was evaluated through ciprofloxacin degradation. Results confirm its efficiency and sustainability while resolving fundamental structure–activity relationships in doped semiconductor systems.
